title: Maahe aza lo namudaar hua
body:
Arsh ke taare hussain..(2)
Zahra ke pyare hussain..(2)
tum ho humare hussain..(2)
hum hai tumhare hussain..(3)
Hussain...
Mahe azaa..
<<MINI>>
Mahe azaa lo namudar hua
ghar me mere bich gaya farshe azaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Jano dile Fatima... Jano dile Fatima
badshah e karbala
ban gaya mehma'n mera

kahi pe nauha kahi par sada e girya hai
shah alaikas salam..(2)
aye mere bekas imam
aap par sab kuch fida

koi uthaega taboot ibn e zahra ka

hogi qayamat bapa
royenge ehle azaa

Gali gali mein sabilo ka ehtemam hai phir
dilo ki pyaas bujhane ka intezam hai phir
ghareeb e zahra ka jari labo'n pe naam hai phir
aake sabilo ke paas
<<DIVIDER>>
jo bhi bujhata hai pyaas
deta ha dil se sadaa
Hussain...
Mujrae jab ke ayaa'n mahe azaa hota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
arsh par matam e shahe shohada hota hai
Har anjuman mein hai sinazani ki tayyari
qadeem e qarz par hoti hai phir azadari
taziye khane khule
<<DIVIDER>>
matami shane khule
hota hai matam bapa

<<DIVIDER>>
ho mere maa baap bhi
